mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repo (tenant_id, name, url, default_branch, description, scan_status, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{name}, #{url}, #{defaultBranch}, #{description}, #{scanStatus}, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repo WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM repo WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE repo SET scan_status = #{scanStatus}, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE repo SET is_deleted = 1, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
